Advanced Dungeons & Dragons - Treasure o.summary: In Treasure of Tarmin the player wanders through a multi-tiered dungeon, each level consisting of a maze and its surrounding hallway. The objective is to slay the Minotaur who guards the Treasure of Tarmin and take his treasure.
